result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: overlapping delivery info text under Tokumaru Ramen Bar is garbled and unreadable.

issues.description: Delivery metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows overlapping/garbled text reading as '25-30rdelivery' - the delivery time e.g. '25-30 min' and delivery fee e.g. '€0 delivery' appear rendered on top of each other and are unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix layout constraints for the metadata row so time, fee and cuisine are laid out sequentially without overlap, with proper spacing and truncation.
